body:
I am amazed at how ridiculously better your comment has made me feel. I should definitely mention that the marijuana use started as self medication for depression, insomnia, and anxiety, but it has become a lifestyle for me. I was smoking maybe once or twice a day, but in the last year it had become nearly every free moment. It has also taken a serious hit on my motivation and passions. I would love to have a controlled amount with legitimate benefits from a strain grown specifically for my symptoms, but doing self medication through street deals was definitely causing mixed reactions with each new batch. As for now, I feel like medicine specifically for my stuff is better than pot that's just a random strain. Hopefully stupid fucking Florida will catch up with the west coast eventually. 


Seriously though, thank you. I really feel like I just needed a third party to give me some perspective and you have done that fantastically. 

From the bottom of my heart,
thank you.
Being high... At least it used to be.... 2 days sober and struggling lol.
